title: HarnessBenchmarkTask
description: Schema for a single benchmark task YAML file in benchmarks/tasks/

id.description: Unique task identifier matching the entry in benchmark-config.yaml

agent.description: Agent to invoke. Leave blank to use the default for the stage.

complexity.description: Rough task complexity. Affects timeout and token budget scaling.

fixtures.description: Input files or inline content provided to the agent before the prompt.

path.description: Repo-relative path where the file is placed.

source.description: Repo-relative path of the fixture source file.

inline.description: Key-value pairs injected as named variables into the prompt template.

prompt.description: The instruction sent to the agent. Use {{variable}} for fixture inline values.

expected_outputs.description: Artefacts the agent must produce. Runner checks these exist after execution.

rubric.description: Weighted rubric items. Scores 0–10; weighted mean = quality_score.

check_value.description: Regex pattern, file path, schema path, or script path depending on check type.

pass_threshold_override.description: Override the global pass_threshold for this task only.

token_budget_override.description: Override max retrieved context tokens for this task.

judge_model.description: Model used for llm-judge criteria. Defaults to the task model.

tags.description: Free-form labels for filtering and grouping.

notes.description: Human-readable notes about this task, known limitations, or change history.
